title: How to Use Apollo.io in Less Than 2 Minutes

hook.text: Presenter intro 'Hey, I'm Kelvin with Apollo' followed by the claim of the most up-to-date lead database and the world's only end-to-end sales platform, reinforced by a heavy kinetic caption 'Most up-to-date lead database'.

cta.text: head over to apollo.io today and create an account for free

summary.tone: Friendly, upbeat and brisk: a smiling on-camera host bookends a fast, signposted product tour ('You can start by', 'Next', 'And finally'), with a bright yellow brand system and light motion-graphics accents.

signature_moments.description: Punched-in presenter shot where three white UI cards (prospect profile, sequence steps, AI email assistant) pop into the empty corners on their exact VO keywords, the email body typing on.
signature_moments.why_premium: Fuses talking head and product in one frame, tying each spoken promise to a concrete UI element so the overview feels designed rather than recorded.

signature_moments.description: The People Search UI dims back while oversized blue numerals appear and count up to the spoken database size (w75-w82).
signature_moments.why_premium: Turns a stat that would be a throwaway line into a visual payoff, using restraint (dimmed UI, one colour, big type) instead of a separate data slide.

signature_moments.description: The meetings page shrinks into a rounded card on the yellow brand stage, a calendar event scales up to full frame, and later the Conversations page dims to spotlight the AI call summary.
signature_moments.why_premium: Camera-like scale moves and spotlighting give a long screen recording structure and focus, and the yellow stage keeps the brand present inside the demo.

hook.evidence: Competent but conventional: a self-introduction (w0-w4) before the claim, a static presenter frame, and one strong kinetic caption on the claim (w10-w15). Bold claim, no question, tension or demo in the first seconds.

clarity.evidence: Each feature is named in the VO and shown at the same moment by cursor and camera push-ins, in a logical order (prospect, list, sequence, A/B and AI, Home, meetings, Conversations, Deals, Analytics, Plays) with explicit signposting. Pace is fast (about 360 words in 119 s) and many features get only a few seconds, which costs some retention.

ui_showcase.evidence: Real product UI throughout, enhanced with overlay stats, floating UI cards, dim-and-spotlight, scale-to-card moves and frequent push-ins on clicked items. Long stretches (s004 about 32 s, s007 about 29 s, s011 about 19 s) are still mostly raw cursor recordings with small UI text.

motion_polish.evidence: Polished bookends (kinetic caption, popping cards, logo assembly, drifting pill end card) and yellow circle wipes, but the middle relies on digital zooms and slides over screen captures with few designed motion graphics. Easing cannot be judged at 2 fps.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchor audio facts plus visuals: a continuous music bed at 120.19 BPM, music hits on the logo sting (x001, x002), and 81 SFX candidates mostly labelled music, swoosh_reverse or unsure with modest CLAP scores, clustered around the stats and transitions (about 20-29 s and 90-113 s) and none detected between about 69 s and 90 s. Integrated loudness is -23.68 LUFS, a quiet master. Functional and on-brand, not a distinctive sound layer.

vo_script_quality.evidence: Natural, confident on-camera delivery with clear transitions ('You can start by', 'Next', 'And finally', 'So if you're ready') and benefit phrasing ('no prospect ever falls through the cracks'). It is essentially a feature list, with one quantified proof point (280M people / 70M companies) and no customer outcome.

brand_consistency.evidence: The brand yellow recurs as logo sting, circle wipes, the stage behind scaled screens and the end card, and the logo appears at open and close. The heavy extended kinetic type of s001 is not reused later, and the overlay blue in s004 is the only other added accent.

works_muted.evidence: Apart from the caption in s001, the cards in s002 and the stat numerals in s004, there are no captions or headings; feature names reach a muted viewer only as small UI labels, so the narrative (what each screen is for) depends on the voice-over.

overall.evidence: A solid presenter-plus-product-tour explainer: good VO-to-UI sync, consistent brand yellow and well-crafted opening and closing graphics, but the long middle is mostly screen recording with camera moves, the hook is a standard self-intro, and the piece leans heavily on audio.

localization_friendliness.notes: English is baked into the kinetic caption (s001), the floating UI cards (s002), every product screen and the end-card handles. The voice-over is delivered on camera by a presenter (s001, s002, s014), so a dub would need lip-sync or re-shooting, and the muted story is weak. The stat overlays and logo stings are the only easily swappable layers.

annotation.focal_element: Presenter seated at a wooden desk facing camera; a two-line kinetic caption overlays the lower half mid-shot
annotation.typography: Very heavy, wide/extended sans in white, sentence case, two centered lines, tight tracking, slight forward slant; small decorative accents around it (four-point sparkle, starburst, short horizontal dashes). Font guess (low confidence): an extended grotesk such as Monument Extended.
annotation.what_happens: Presenter introduces himself and Apollo (w0-w4) in a medium-wide studio shot with a laptop, plant and ring light. Around 1.5 s a large, ghosted version of the caption scales/fades in and settles by 2.0 s into 'Most up-to-date lead database', timed to the spoken phrase (w10-w15); the accents pop in by 2.5 s, the caption shrinks slightly around 3.5-4.5 s and is gone by 5.0 s. The rest of the shot (w17-w30) is plain presenter; the 8.0 s frame already shows a tighter framing, likely the start of the next shot.
annotation.build_rebuild: Over a full-bleed presenter clip, show a two-line extended-sans white caption that scales down from about 130% with a blur-to-sharp fade over ~0.4 s when its phrase is spoken, pop small sparkle/starburst/dash accents around it 0.3 s later, then fade it out after ~3 s.

annotation.focal_element: Presenter in a tighter punch-in framing, surrounded by floating white UI cards (prospect profile, sequence steps, AI email assistant)
on_screen_text: Hi Alissa, Glad to connect. Looks like you're growing the account management team quite a bit right now. Let's find some time to talk about your goals and how
annotation.typography: Product-UI typography: clean geometric/neo-grotesk sans, medium-bold names and card titles, regular-weight grey secondary lines, small bold labels on blue pill buttons, sentence/title case, normal tracking. Email body is typed on progressively (keyframe shows a partial sentence ending 'how').
annotation.what_happens: Cut to a tighter crop of the presenter, hands clasped. UI cards pop in on cue with the VO: a prospect profile card top-left at about 9.0 s ('find the right prospects', w36-w39), a three-step sequence card right at about 10.0 s ('engage with them at the right time', w40-w46), and an 'AI email assistant' card left at about 11.5 s ('using the right message', w47-w50) whose body text types on through the rest of the shot. All three cards stay on screen through w51-w64 while the presenter finishes the platform pitch; the cards appear to drift slightly.
annotation.build_rebuild: Over a punched-in presenter clip, pop three rounded white UI cards with soft drop shadows into the empty corners (scale 0.9 to 1 with fade, ~0.3 s each), each triggered on its VO keyword, and typewrite the email-assistant body text at roughly 20 characters per second.

annotation.focal_element: Black Apollo.io wordmark centered on a warm yellow background with large lighter concentric circles
annotation.typography: Logo wordmark: bold geometric sans, lowercase 'pollo.io' with a stylised triangular 'A' mark, tight tracking.
annotation.what_happens: Hard cut to a full-bleed yellow brand card in the speech gap between w64 and w65. At 16.5 s only a stroke of the 'A' is visible; by 17.0 s the wordmark has assembled (letters still resolving) and is complete by 17.5 s. Lighter yellow circles sweep/expand from the right and a thin white arc crosses the lower left while the logo holds. Music hits are detected at 16.42 s and 17.84 s (x001, x002); there is no voice-over in this shot.
annotation.build_rebuild: On a flat yellow background, draw on the logo's 'A' stroke then mask-reveal the remaining letters left to right over ~0.5 s, while two lighter-yellow circles scale out from the right edge with ease-out over ~2 s and a thin white arc slides across the lower left; hold the lockup ~2 s.

annotation.focal_element: Apollo People Search UI, first with oversized blue stat overlays (281.1M / 70M), then the expanded filter grid, a LinkedIn profile with the Apollo Chrome extension, a saved-list table and a sequence editor
on_screen_text: Start your people search by applying any filter in the left panel
The fastest growing, most loved sales technology on Earth.
annotation.typography: Overlay stats: very large geometric sans, medium/semibold weight, numerals plus uppercase M, tight tracking, set in a saturated blue directly over the faded UI; all other text is native product UI sans (small, regular weight, sentence case). Font guess (low confidence): Inter-like.
annotation.what_happens: A long continuous cursor-guided product walkthrough synced to the VO (w65-w157). Opens on the People Search page (the corner of a brand-yellow disc is visible at 0:19.5, suggesting a shape wipe in); the cursor hovers the Total tab and the UI fades back while a giant '281.1M' appears, then a second number counts up 33M -> 67M -> 70M on 'over 280 million people and 70 million companies' (w75-w82), then both fade out. On 'dozens of advanced filters' (w88-w91) More Filters opens a multi-column filter grid, the view pushes in, the cursor hovers Job Change and Technologies (w94-w97) and expands Buying Intent with High/Medium/Low/None options (w111-w113). On the Chrome-extension line (w117-w134) a slightly tilted, shadowed LinkedIn profile window slides up over the app, scales to fill frame, and the Apollo extension side panel opens with contact details. Around w135-w139 the LinkedIn window shrinks and slides away to reveal a list table where rows are checked and Save is clicked; a yellow circular wipe (about 0:49.5-0:50.0) then leads into the sequence editor (w150-w156), which pushes in and the cursor clicks 'Add a step'. Visible zoom/push-ins and window scale moves happen within the shot; exact easing not visible from 2 fps sheets.
annotation.build_rebuild: Record the product UI at high resolution, then in the editor animate a camera (scale/translate) over the recording per VO phrase, dim the UI to ~40% opacity and overlay large blue sans numerals that fade in and count up (0 -> 70M) on the spoken stats, and composite separately recorded windows (LinkedIn page) as shadowed cards that slide up, scale to full frame and shrink away, joining sections with a brand-yellow circle wipe.

annotation.focal_element: Right-hand step-picker card listing Phone call, Action item and LinkedIn tasks over the dimmed sequence editor, with the cursor on the 'Add a step' button
annotation.typography: Native product UI: medium-weight sans titles in sentence case with smaller regular grey descriptions beneath; no added motion-graphics type.
annotation.what_happens: A half-second (one sampled frame) tight crop showing the moment after 'Add a step' is clicked: the background sequence dims and the step-picker list appears at the right edge, cropped by the zoom, on 'emails,' (w158). It reads as the zoomed-in start of a camera move that continues in s005->s006; detail beyond the single frame is not visible.
annotation.build_rebuild: Cut to a ~0.5 s 1.6x-scaled crop of the recording anchored on the clicked button, with a dark overlay on the page and the white step-picker panel entering at the right, then pull the camera back in the next shot.

annotation.focal_element: Centered 'Select a sequence step' modal listing Automatic email, Manual email, Phone call, Action item and LinkedIn task step types
annotation.transition_other: Camera pull-back/re-frame from the s005 close-up to the full centered modal (frame at 0:52.5 is mid-move, modal partially off-centre)
on_screen_text: Add a step for the sequence to follow and automate for you.
annotation.typography: Native product UI: modal title in semibold sans, sentence case; list items medium weight with small grey descriptions; purple 'AI available!' pill badges with sparkle icon.
annotation.what_happens: The view settles on the full modal centered over the dimmed sequence page while the VO lists 'phone calls, and LinkedIn touches' (w159-w163); the cursor glides down the list hovering Automatic email, Phone call/Action item and LinkedIn: send connection request in step with the spoken channels, then moves to the close X; at about 0:57.0 the modal is gone and the full sequence overview is visible as 'You can also utilize' (w164-w166) begins.
annotation.build_rebuild: Keep the modal centered with the page behind dimmed (black overlay ~50%), and script the cursor to hover each step type exactly on the matching VO word before closing the modal into the next section.

annotation.focal_element: A cursor-guided tour across several Apollo screens: sequence overview with A/B test, email template editor with the AI assistant menu, the Home control center (stat cards, Workstreams tabs, Tasks table), a 'Book a meeting with Alex' scheduling page, and a Google Calendar event with the Apollo side panel
annotation.typography: Native product UI only: small neo-grotesk sans, regular weight body, semibold card titles and stat numerals, sentence case, normal tracking; no added motion-graphics type in this shot. Font guess (low confidence): Inter-like.
annotation.what_happens: Long continuous walkthrough synced to the VO (w167-w253). On 'utilize A-B testing' (w167-w170) the cursor hovers and clicks 'Add A/B Test' in the sequence overview; on 'and A-I to optimize your outreach' (w171-w184) the row menu opens Edit, the template editor appears with a preview pane, and the AI assistant menu (Generate email, Personalize email, Rephrase selection) opens. On 'Next, the Home tab' (w185-w188) the cursor clicks Home and the camera pushes in on the control center stat cards and Workstreams; the cursor steps across Recent replies, Recommended prospects and Tasks in time with 'who to respond to, who to target next, and what tasks' (w197-w213). The view then zooms tighter onto the Tasks table (about 1:11.5-1:14.5) with the cursor hovering the email action on the first row during w214-w222, then pulls back out. On 'leverage meetings' (w230-w231) the cursor clicks Meetings and a horizontal slide reveals a 'Book a meeting with Alex' page; a date and 10:00 AM time are picked, Confirm is clicked and the Enter details form appears (w232-w238). Around 1:20.5 (w239-w241) the page shrinks into a rounded card over a brand-yellow background with lighter circles, then a Google Calendar event popup slides in on that yellow stage and scales up to full frame by 1:23.0; on 'before and after every meeting' (w246-w250) the cursor clicks inside the event and the Apollo Chrome-extension side panel slides in from the right. Exact easing is not visible at 2 fps.
annotation.build_rebuild: Composite a sequence of separately recorded product screens on one timeline, driving a virtual camera (scale/translate push-ins and pull-backs) per VO phrase, joining screens with horizontal slides, and for the meetings beat scale the full-frame page down into a rounded shadowed card over a yellow brand background with soft circles before scaling the next screen (calendar) back up to full frame.

annotation.focal_element: Apollo Conversations page for a recorded call: Call Summary panel (Outcome, Next Steps, Objections) beside the call video player and transcript
on_screen_text: This is a demo conversation. To begin using Conversations, reach out to your admin to set up Conversations.
annotation.typography: Native product UI: banner headline in bold white sans on a dark navy bar, panel headings semibold sentence case, body regular grey; the recorded slide inside the video player uses a large bold black sans title. No added overlay type.
annotation.what_happens: At 1:26.5 the previous calendar/extension screen is still visible as a strip at the left while the Conversations page occupies the rest, reading as a push/slide from the right on 'closed one with Conversations' (w254-w257). The cursor moves over the Call Summary outcome text as the VO says 'AI-powered video call summaries' (w258-w265). From about 1:28.0 the rest of the page darkens to a grey overlay while the Call Summary cards (Outcome, Next Steps, Objections) stay bright, spotlighting the AI summary; the cursor rests near the cards. Transition direction is inferred from a single frame.
annotation.build_rebuild: Push the new screen recording in from the right over ~0.4 s, then on the 'summaries' keyword fade a ~40% black overlay over the whole frame while keeping a masked cut-out (or a duplicate un-dimmed layer) of the summary panel bright to spotlight it.

annotation.focal_element: The same Conversations page with the Call Summary panel spotlit, then the dim lifting and the view pushing in
annotation.typography: Native product UI: semibold sentence-case panel headings, regular body text; banner headline bold white sans on navy. No added overlay type.
annotation.what_happens: A 0.7 s shot over 'and coaching tools' (w266-w268): at 1:30.0 the page is still dimmed with the summary cards bright; by 1:30.5 the dim overlay is gone and the frame is slightly scaled up and shifted (left nav and right edge cropped), i.e. the spotlight fades out as a camera push-in begins. The detected crossfade likely corresponds to the overlay fade; only two sampled frames are available.
annotation.build_rebuild: Fade the black dim overlay from ~40% to 0 over ~0.3 s while starting a slow scale-up of the screen recording (about 1.0 to 1.1) toward the upper left.

annotation.focal_element: Zoomed-in left navigation and Call Summary panel, with the cursor moving to and clicking the 'Deals' nav item, which opens the Deals board

annotation.typography: Native product UI: regular-weight sans nav labels in sentence case, small green 'New' pill badge, semibold page title. No added overlay type.
annotation.what_happens: Tight crop of the left half of the Conversations page; the cursor travels down the nav from about 1:31.0 and lands on 'Deals' (marked New) as the VO says 'while Deal Intelligence' (w269-w271); the item is clicked around 1:32.0 and by 1:32.5 the Deals pipeline board (filters column plus kanban-style deal columns) is on screen, as 'provides a' (w272-w273) begins. annotation.focal_element: The cursor moving through the Apollo app: Deals board, then the Analytics dashboards list, the Email Engagement Performance dashboard and its bar charts, then the Plays page and its All templates button
on_screen_text: Get started with your own custom Reports and Dashboards from the training videos or find a deeper dive within our Knowledge Base.
annotation.typography: Native product UI text only: small sans-serif (low-confidence guess: Inter or a similar system UI face), medium-weight sentence-case page titles, regular-weight labels and chart axes, normal tracking; no added captions or motion-graphic type.
annotation.what_happens: A long cursor-guided screen recording under the voice-over for Deal Intelligence, Analytics and Plays (w269-w339): the Deals kanban board is shown with slow digital zoom/pan reframes, the cursor clicks Analytics in the sidebar, the dashboards list appears, a search narrows it and Email Engagement Performance is opened (a brief loading state, then horizontal bar charts), a chart is opened in detail, then the cursor clicks Plays and moves to the All templates button, which opens a modal at the very end of the shot.
annotation.build_rebuild: Play a real 1280x720 screen capture of the app and animate a CSS transform scale/translate on the capture layer (about 1.0 to 1.4x, ease-in-out over roughly 0.5 s) at each click so the camera pushes in on the clicked sidebar item and then pulls back to the full page.

annotation.typography: Native product UI: bold sans-serif sentence-case card titles, regular-weight centered body copy, small outlined button labels; no added type.

It reads as the first frames of the modal open plus the start of a zoom that resolves in s013.

annotation.focal_element: The full Play templates modal centered on a dimmed page, with its category sidebar and three-column card grid

annotation.what_happens: Under the line about streamlining with Apollo's plays and the 'So if you're ready to close more deals' setup (w336-w347), the view settles on the whole Play templates modal; the framing drifts slightly (a small zoom/pan) and the card grid scrolls down a little to reveal a third row, while the cursor stays parked at the top right. The last contact-sheet frame (1:56.000) already shows the presenter, so the cut to s014 lands within a frame or two of the detected boundary.

annotation.focal_element: The presenter seated at a wooden desk, hands clasped, speaking to camera, with a closed silver laptop at left, a plant and a ring light in the dark background
annotation.what_happens: Hard cut back to the presenter on a locked-off medium shot as he delivers the call to action, 'head over to apollo.io today and create an account for free' (w348-w359), smiling at the end; no on-screen URL or button is shown in this shot.
annotation.build_rebuild: Cut to a locked-off 16:9 medium shot of the presenter centered at a desk against a dark set with a shallow-focus plant and ring light, and hold it for the full spoken CTA with no overlays.

annotation.composition_other: End-card layout: wordmark top-centre, a row of three social handles bottom-left, a two-line 'Subscribe' label right of centre, with large empty areas that look reserved for platform end-screen elements (inferred).
annotation.focal_element: Black Apollo.io wordmark top-centre on a brand-yellow background patterned with rows of lighter-yellow rounded pill shapes
annotation.transition_other: Detector flags 'other' from the presenter shot; the first sampled frame (1:59.5) is already yellow with only fragments of the logo, so the transition itself is not visible at 2 fps.
annotation.typography: Logo wordmark: bold geometric sans with a stylised triangular 'A', lowercase 'pollo.io', tight tracking. 'Subscribe' in small bold sans over a regular-weight handle line; social handles in small regular sans beside Facebook, LinkedIn and X glyphs; mixed case as in the handles, normal tracking.
annotation.what_happens: End card with no voice-over (last word w359 ends before the shot starts). At 1:59.5 only scattered logo fragments are visible; by 2:00.0 the wordmark is resolving letter by letter and the social row and 'Subscribe' label are mask-revealing in; everything is complete by 2:00.5. The card then holds for about 18.7 s while three rows of lighter-yellow pill shapes drift slowly sideways in alternating directions (top and bottom rows rightward, middle row leftward, as read from frame-to-frame positions). Anchors show music candidates at 119.9, 122.1 and 124.4 s (x079-x081) and beat tracking stops at about 125.1 s, so the music probably ends partway through; the rest of the audio cannot be confirmed.
annotation.build_rebuild: On a flat brand-yellow canvas, lay out three rows of lighter-yellow rounded pills that translate horizontally at a constant slow speed (alternating direction per row, looping), assemble the wordmark from fragments into place over ~1 s with ease-out, mask-reveal the social-handle row and Subscribe label at the same time, then hold until the end.
